dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Smiling makes the world a more beautiful place! See any toys you like?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the toys...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Oh, children love them. Intricate things, they are.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: I've got toys for adults too, if you'd like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adult toys...?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Sorry, I should have been more specific. Some toys need adult supervision — kites for example.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Come war and famine or the peace and prosperity we know today, happiness is always something worth striving for, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Take care now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about Rex Lapis...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis? I understand. Does your little one back home also want a Rex Lapis-themed toy?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Have a look: dragon horn tops, stone dice, a dragon-shaped wooden sword, a kite with Rex Lapis' portrait on it... which would you like?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Ah... So you're just asking around. I see. Rex Lapis-themed toys are so very popular among the children, so I naturally thought that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you have to sell here?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: What you see is what I've got. Have a look, perhaps there might be something that catches your eye.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Go on, buy a little something for the kids.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: I'm not here to make big profits. Just an old granny out enjoying the festive atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you selling?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.
